_info: CODE SHIELD lock list (guardrails/shield.py). Each lock: a file (and optionally a region between '# SHIELD: <name>' and '# SHIELD-END: <name>' in any comment style), a reason, the tests that protect it and the approved fingerprint.
The fingerprint is never written by hand: 'python3 guardrails/shield.py approve <name> --reason "..."' writes it and logs the change to docs/SHIELD_LOG.md.
New lock: add it here with an empty fingerprint, mark the region in the code, then approve. {tests} in a runner command is replaced by the lock's test names.

locks.name: discount-rule
locks.reason: Pricing rule agreed with the business: 1% per loyalty year, capped at 10%, nothing under 50. A silent change here costs money.
